title: Stable Audio 3 gets two routes
summary:
Two Stable Audio 3 options and Mercury 2 joined the models, while the catalog got clearer about what a music generation costs.

Stable Audio 3 Medium replaced 2.5 for paid music generation via fal, while Stable Audio 3 Large was added through Stability AI’s official API in alpha. Both accept text prompts or reference audio and support generations up to 380 seconds. Medium keeps the older Stable Audio names as aliases, though its output changes from WAV to MP3.

Inception Labs’ paid-only Mercury 2 was added as `mercury`, with tool support and a 128,000-token context window. Usage tracking also accounts for its cached-input and reasoning tokens.

Stable Audio Medium and Large now show flat per-generation prices instead of estimated per-second rates. The pricing panel is clearer on mobile, and the README’s Latest News section was refreshed with June 22 updates.

highlights.title: Stable Audio 3 Large
highlights.text: Generate music from a prompt or supply reference audio for audio-to-audio generation, with durations up to 380 seconds. The model is paid-only and in alpha. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Stable%20Audio%203%20Large).

highlights.title: Stable Audio 3 Medium
highlights.text: Generate music from text or use `reference_audio` for style transfer, with up to 380 seconds of MP3 output. Existing Stable Audio names remain aliases. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Stable%20Audio%203%20Medium).

highlights.title: Mercury 2 joins text
highlights.text: Use `mercury` for text generation with tool support and a 128,000-token context window. The model is paid-only. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mercury).
